note: The platform's upgrade dependency graph (ENGINEERING_MANAGEMENT.md, 2026-11-12). One record per thing made, bought or learned. 'by': external = bought or outsourced seed; workshop = an existing workshop process (the printer); platform = made on the machine; hybrid = the machine plus named external steps; measurement = knowledge a bench run produces. humanMinutes are estimates for planning, not measurements. Checked by `fieldc upgrades`: no record may depend on itself, and everything not external names its tolerance and how it is inspected.

records.what: 40 kHz open-type transmitters and one receiver (Murata MA40S4S/R or a listed alternate)
records.gain: the radiating elements; the only catalog tone

records.what: controller board (RP2350B), TC4427A drivers, 18 V supply, air-temperature sensor
records.gain: 32 coherent drive channels, one receive channel, a USB link to the twin

records.what: P0 frame: two aperture plates A1 (4 × 4), four M4 rods, probe bar
records.tolerance: pin holes ±0.2 mm; gap set by nuts to ±0.5 mm. Neither is held by the print: calibration measures what was built
records.inspection: calipers on the rod square and the gap; then the calibration's phase map
records.gain: the platform's datum (the rods) and its first aperture

records.what: calibration tool: probe receiver on the bar + `Calibration.program` through the link
records.tolerance: probe face within ±0.2 mm of the mid-plane (9° of phase at 40 kHz); electrical chain ±1° (G-HW1–3, simulated)
records.inspection: repeat the calibration with the probe removed and refitted: the per-channel phases must repeat within 5°
records.gain: each channel's gain and phase as built; reused by every later aperture
records.status: software tested on the simulated controller

records.what: the element measured: level against drive, resonance and Q, unit-to-unit scatter, the plate's reflection
records.tolerance: relative level ±0.5 dB, phase ±5°, resonance ±100 Hz; absolute level needs a calibrated microphone (external, quote) or stays ±3 dB (the datasheet)
records.inspection: the same sweep on 34 units; one unit re-measured ten times for repeatability
records.gain: replaces four assumptions in `ElementSpec` (face velocity, Q, efficiency, scaling) for the 40 kHz part

records.what: hold, move, release repeated on the bench against the twin's prediction
records.tolerance: bead within 0.5 mm of each waypoint in ten runs of ten
records.inspection: camera, two views, scale from the 10.5 mm can pitch
records.gain: the first manipulation milestone; the twin's force model checked once

records.what: aperture module A2: the smallest aperture on which beads are placed touching (G-B1, G-B2) in the calibrated twin
records.tolerance: as A1; the element count and gap are chosen in the twin on K-ELEM's numbers
records.inspection: calibration; then a five-bead row on the bench
records.gain: placement next to a placed bead: A1 misses by 1–2 mm in the twin (2026-11-12)
records.status: open: A1 fails G-B1 and G-B2 in the twin

records.what: joining: UV-curing adhesive on the beads and a 405 nm lamp
records.status: candidate; cure dose and bond strength unmeasured

records.what: first self-made part: scan phantom T1, four Ø1.5 mm beads bonded as a tetrahedron
records.tolerance: bead centres within 0.15 mm of the drawing (a tenth of a bead); every bond carries 10 × a bead's weight
records.inspection: camera, two views at 20 µm per pixel; a drop test from 10 mm
records.gain: a known sub-wavelength target for registering the receive module; external steps: bought beads and adhesive, hand feed of each bead

records.what: receive module: receivers on the aperture plates, records through `MachineBackend`
records.tolerance: receiver positions from calibration against T1
records.inspection: T1 located within 0.5 mm from its echo
records.gain: the machine sees what it placed: closed-loop placement

records.what: custom transmitters at the mold's tones (53–97 kHz, Ø4–8 mm): no catalog part exists
records.gain: tones a mold needs; the RH-1 face's elements

records.what: aperture module A3: several tones, mold-capable
records.tolerance: per element gain ±2 %, phase ±5° after calibration; air known to 0.1 K (study S5)
records.inspection: calibration; powder ring mold against G-M1
records.gain: powder molds: the route to parts finer than a bead
a fixed optical wavefront without active channels

records.what: replicated optical working plates from the master
records.tolerance: relief height to λ·δφ/(2π(n−1)): about 17 nm at 532 nm, n 1.5, 0.1 rad (example only)
records.inspection: a bought interferometer or profilometer: not owned
records.gain: none identified for the acoustic platform yet
